decisions.reason: The source defines settlement-currency disclosure and selection for ETH/USDC checkout availability; it does not change the deferred Transak fiat-conversion, wallet-provisioning, or mint-destination requirements.
The connected-wallet USDC mint requirement remains valid unchanged; the source changes only the separate checkout disclosure and currency-selection behavior.
Currency disclosure and selection do not alter the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source does not change the USD mint price, affiliate commission, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
The optional gratuity's availability, placement, presets, and custom-amount behavior are independent of settlement-currency disclosure and selection.
The source does not affect book-cover sizing or rendering on the NFT detail page.
Requiring currency disclosure or selection does not change the rule that only finalized successful mints may be reported as owned NFTs.
The source mandates checkout UI behavior but does not instruct that the approved FAQ copy or its listed topics be revised.
Primary-checkout currency disclosure and selection do not alter secondary-sale royalty amount, disclosure, funding behavior, or enforcement.
Although both behaviors occur around checkout, the source does not change referral eligibility or the prohibition on self-referrals.
Settlement-currency display and selection do not change the missing-or-invalid-referral commission amount, trigger, or recipient selection.
The source does not alter the randomness provider, on-chain selection method, fairness guarantees, or applicable prize draws.
